PAGE TITLE: Message from the Administrator (continued)

PHOTOS:
- Portrait photo of Bill Nelson with signature "Bill Nelson" below it.

KEY FACTS:
- Launches of NASA's SpaceX Crew-8 and SpaceX Crew-9 to the ISS marked in FY 2024.
- Fleet of more than two dozen satellites and instruments used to study Earth as a system.
- NASA-Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) satellite is a joint mission.
- X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft publicly unveiled in January 2024.
- X-66 Sustainable Flight Demonstrator helps U.S. achieve net-zero aviation emissions by 2050.
- 2024-2026 STEM Engagement Strategic Implementation Plan supports NASA's STEM strategy.
